hypotheses.justification: Implied by `[FiniteDimensional (IntermediateField.adjoin k ({x₁} : Set F₁)) F₁]`. The proof uses EssFiniteType only to call `dCoordGenerates_of_isCurveOver`. Step 1: Mathlib has `instance [Finite S] : Algebra.EssFiniteType F (adjoin F S)` (FieldTheory/IntermediateField/Adjoin/Algebra.lean), and `{x₁}` is finite, so k⟮x₁⟯ is essentially of finite type over k. Step 2: F₁ is finite over k⟮x₁⟯, so it is of finite type (`Module.Finite.finiteType`) and hence essentially of finite type (`Algebra.EssFiniteType.of_finiteType`). Step 3: with the standard scalar tower k → k⟮x₁⟯ → F₁, `Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp` (RingTheory/EssentialFiniteness.lean) gives `Algebra.EssFiniteType k F₁`. This holds whether x₁ is algebraic or transcendental, so there are no degenerate cases. Adding `haveI := Algebra.EssFiniteType.comp k k⟮x₁⟯ F₁` at the start of the proof leaves the rest unchanged. These lemmas were checked in Mathlib master only, since the library has no local Mathlib copy.
